title: Search stored reply excerpts under 50 ms

proofs.run: read the machine load first (uptime): the timing is judged only under load 12; then run the cargo proof below on the quiet machine

mutants.find: ORDER BY score DESC, c.source_key || char(31) || c.item_key || char(31) || CAST(c.chunk_no AS TEXT) ASC LIMIT
